narrative:
Harrison County has 9,433 registered voters, with 21.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 23.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 33.2% of registrants.
